name: OxaPay Crypto Payment Gateway for Kadence Memberships
author: OxaPay

sections.description:
OxaPay is a secure cryptocurrency payment gateway that enables Kadence Memberships websites to accept cryptocurrency payments for memberships and subscriptions.

Kadence Memberships was formerly known as Restrict Content Pro. This plugin keeps compatibility with the existing WordPress.org plugin slug while updating the public branding to Kadence Memberships.

With OxaPay, merchants can offer fast and secure crypto payments and receive payments through a simple cryptocurrency checkout flow.

OxaPay supports a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including:

  • Bitcoin (BTC)
  • Ethereum (ETH)
  • BNB (BNB)
  • TRON (TRX)
  • Tether (USDT)
  • Dogecoin (DOGE)
  • Toncoin (TON)
  • Litecoin (LTC)
  • Bitcoin Cash (BCH)
  • Polygon (MATIC)
  • Shiba Inu (SHIB)
  • Solana (SOL)
  • Monero (XMR)
  • USD Coin (USDC)
  • Ripple (XRP)

Supported currencies may vary depending on OxaPay availability and your account configuration.

OxaPay website | Sign up | Contact us

Features

  • Crypto payment gateway for Kadence Memberships
  • Secure invoice-based cryptocurrency checkout
  • Support for multiple cryptocurrencies
  • Merchant API Key configuration
  • Automatic payment callback handling
  • Fast checkout redirection through OxaPay
  • No recurring billing requirement
  • Simple setup from the Kadence Memberships payment settings

Low fees

OxaPay fees start from 0.4%, depending on the service and account conditions. For the latest pricing details, please check the official OxaPay pricing page.

Easy integration

The plugin connects Kadence Memberships with OxaPay, allowing membership websites to accept crypto payments without building a custom payment integration.

Secure payment flow

The plugin creates payment invoices through the OxaPay API and redirects customers to the OxaPay payment page. Payment status updates are handled through OxaPay callbacks.

Multiple cryptocurrencies

OxaPay supports multiple digital assets, allowing merchants to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies supported by OxaPay.

24/7 support

OxaPay provides documentation and support to help merchants integrate and manage crypto payments.

External services

This plugin connects to OxaPay, a third-party cryptocurrency payment gateway, to create and manage cryptocurrency payment invoices.

Service used:

  • OxaPay: https://oxapay.com/

What the service is used for:

  • Creating cryptocurrency payment invoices.
  • Receiving a payment URL for customer checkout.
  • Receiving payment status callbacks after the customer completes or does not complete the payment.

What data is sent and when:

  • When a customer chooses OxaPay during checkout, the plugin sends invoice details to OxaPay.
  • The data may include the payment amount, currency, order/reference identifiers, customer email when available, callback URL, return URL, and description.
  • The request also includes the Merchant API Key configured by the site administrator for authentication.

API endpoint used:

  • https://api.oxapay.com/v1/payment/invoice

Service provider policies:

  • Terms and Privacy Policy: https://oxapay.com/terms-privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for OxaPay Crypto Payment Gateway for Kadence Memberships.
  4. Install and activate the plugin.
  5. Make sure Kadence Memberships is installed and activated.
  6. Go to your OxaPay merchant dashboard and copy your Merchant API Key.
  7. Open the Kadence Memberships payment settings. In some installations, the admin menu may still appear as Restrict or RCP.
  8. Enable OxaPay and enter your Merchant API Key.
  9. Save the settings.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin for Kadence Memberships or Restrict Content Pro?

This plugin is for Kadence Memberships. Kadence Memberships was formerly known as Restrict Content Pro, so some technical references, hooks, or the WordPress.org slug may still include Restrict Content Pro or RCP.

Does this plugin support existing Restrict Content Pro installations?

The plugin is designed for Kadence Memberships while keeping compatibility with the existing WordPress.org slug and RCP-based technical integration where applicable. Please test on a staging site before updating a production website.

How does the OxaPay crypto payment gateway plugin work?

After installation and configuration, the plugin adds OxaPay as a payment method in Kadence Memberships. When a customer selects OxaPay during checkout, the plugin creates an OxaPay invoice and redirects the customer to the payment page.

Which API endpoint is used for payment requests?

The plugin sends invoice creation requests to:

https://api.oxapay.com/v1/payment/invoice

What data does the plugin send to the OxaPay API?

The plugin sends the Merchant API Key and invoice details such as amount, currency, order/reference identifiers, customer email when available, callback URL, return URL, and payment description.

Which cryptocurrencies does OxaPay support?

OxaPay supports a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether, USD Coin, TRON, Litecoin, and others. Availability may vary depending on OxaPay support and merchant account configuration.

Does this plugin support recurring payments?

This plugin is intended for invoice-based crypto payments. Cryptocurrency payments are processed as non-recurring payments unless a separate recurring workflow is implemented.

Where can I get support?

For support, contact the OxaPay team:

https://t.me/danielsup
